9c23325565.q: What cancer diagnosis survival rate changed Kelsey Kitsch's perspective on success and time allocation?
9c23325565.a: Kelsey was diagnosed with cancer when her third child was two months old, with a 17% survival rate prognosis. This prompted her to redefine success to include aliveness, relationships, and whole-life value alongside financial accomplishment.
